name: Exp_3Parabolic
summary: This EA uses three Parabolic SAR indicators on different timeframes (H6, H3, H1) to generate trend-following trade signals. A buy signal occurs when all three SAR values are below their respective close prices, with the fastest timeframe showing a fresh bullish reversal. Sell signals are the inverse. Positions are managed with fixed stop loss and take profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA在三个不同周期（H6、H3、H1）上使用抛物线SAR指标生成趋势跟踪交易信号。买入信号需要三个周期的SAR均在收盘价下方且最快周期出现看涨反转，卖出信号反之。持仓以固定止损止盈管理。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于多周期抛物线SAR共振确认趋势方向，只有在三个时间框架的趋势一致时才开仓。入场条件为：买入需SAR1<SAR2<SAR3均低于各自收盘价，且第三周期SAR从上方穿越到下方（Sar_3[0]>Close_3[0]且Sar_3[1]<Close_3[1]）；卖出条件反之。出场条件包括SAR反转触发的方向性平仓信号以及固定点数的止损止盈。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值为固定手数，正值为按存款比例计算。资金管理依赖外部TradeAlgorithms.mqh库函数实现，包括BuyPositionOpen和SellPositionOpen等。该策略使用新柱检测机制避免重复信号，但在信号柱索引为0时会在每个tick都进行计算，可能增加不必要的运算负担。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on multi-timeframe Parabolic SAR confluence to confirm trend direction, only opening positions when all three timeframes align. Entry conditions: a buy requires all three SAR values below their respective close prices, with the fastest timeframe showing a fresh bullish reversal (Sar_3[0]>Close_3[0] and Sar_3[1]<Close_3[1]); sell conditions are the inverse. Exit conditions include SAR reversal-triggered directional close signals and fixed stop loss/take profit in points. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent a share of the deposit. Money management relies on external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions such as BuyPositionOpen and SellPositionOpen. The strategy uses a new bar detection mechanism to avoid repeated signals, but when SignalBar is 0, calculations occur on every tick, potentially increasing unnecessary computational overhead.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 存款比例或固定手数，负值为手数
parameters.description_en: Trade deposit ratio; negative = fixed lot

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线索引

pros: 多周期共振确认趋势，减少假信号
三重时间框架过滤提高了入场质量
新柱检测机制避免同一信号重复开仓
买卖开平仓权限可独立控制，灵活性好
使用抛物线SAR自带跟踪止损特性，趋势跟踪能力较强
pros_en: Multi-timeframe confluence confirmation reduces false signals
Triple timeframe filtering improves entry quality
New bar detection mechanism prevents duplicate signal entries
Buy/sell open/close permissions can be controlled independently for flexibility
Parabolic SAR inherently provides trailing stop-like behavior for strong trend following
cons: 三重SAR共振信号较少，可能长时间无交易机会
SAR在震荡市中频繁反转产生亏损信号
缺少震荡市场过滤机制，横盘时容易反复开平仓
止损1000点止盈2000点的固定比例不适合所有品种
依赖外部TradeAlgorithms.mqh库，核心交易逻辑不可见
cons_en: Triple SAR confluence signals are infrequent, potentially leading to long periods without trades
SAR frequently reverses in ranging markets, generating losing signals
No ranging market filter, prone to repeated open/close cycles during sideways movement
Fixed 1000-point SL and 2000-point TP ratio is not suitable for all instruments
Core trading logic depends on external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library, making it opaque
improvements: 增加ADX或波动率过滤器，避免在震荡市场中频繁交易
增加追踪止损功能，让盈利仓位获得更多趋势空间
优化MM参数说明，明确正负值的计算逻辑
添加最大回撤保护和最大连续亏损限制
improvements_en: Add ADX or volatility filter to avoid frequent trading in ranging markets
Add trailing stop functionality to let winning positions capture more trend movement
Clarify MM parameter documentation to explicitly explain positive vs negative value calculation logic
Add maximum drawdown protection and maximum consecutive loss limits

risk_points: SAR在震荡市中频繁反转可能造成连续小额亏损
固定止损止盈不适应不同波动率品种
外部库TradeAlgorithms.mqh的仓位管理逻辑不可审查
当SignalBar=0时每个tick都计算，可能在剧烈波动时重复触发
risk_points_en: SAR frequent reversals in ranging markets may cause consecutive small losses
Fixed stop loss and take profit do not adapt to instruments with different volatility
External TradeAlgorithms.mqh position management logic cannot be audited
When SignalBar=0, calculations occur on every tick, potentially causing repeated triggers during volatile moves
